name: two_room_thermal
notes: Two-room thermal deviations from a desired equilibrium.
Ci in J/K, conductances ai in W/K, inputs in W (positive heats, negative cools).
The inputs are unconstrained power deviations, not heating-only actuators.
K and L redesigned for this configuration
Accumulated cost is sum_t (S_t' Qc S_t + U_t' Rc U_t) with no factor of dt.
disclaimer: Spectral radii and Riccati residuals are for the continuous-state linear Gaussian model with the fixed steady-state gains. They do not apply to nonlinear plants or quantized controllers.
